electric-signal.$description: Electric Signal — Brand accent — icons, link text, small functional highlights, inline code accents

lavender-mist.$description: Lavender Mist — Brand signature — terminal color of the hero aurora gradient, decorative washes

sky-wash.$description: Sky Wash — Accent — subdued link blue for secondary text-level links

ember.$description: Ember — Accent — warm decorative token used sparingly in illustration/code contexts

amber-glow.$description: Amber Glow — Accent — warm decorative token, secondary highlight

sunburst.$description: Sunburst — Accent — high-energy punctuation for icons and inline emphasis

forest-pulse.$description: Forest Pulse — Green supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis

vivid-mint.$description: Vivid Mint — Accent — saturated green for badges and inline highlights

pink-static.$description: Pink Static — Accent — chromatic pink for decorative highlights and illustration

midnight.$description: Midnight — Page canvas, deepest gradient stop, true black borders

obsidian.$description: Obsidian — Primary card surface — the floating canvas around the hero card

charcoal.$description: Charcoal — Elevated surface — input fields, nested cards, nav pill background

graphite.$description: Graphite — Mid-dark surface — button rest states, shadow base color

slate.$description: Slate — Mid neutral — secondary borders, disabled controls

fog.$description: Fog — Muted body text, secondary metadata

ash.$description: Ash — Tertiary text, button labels on dark surfaces

silver.$description: Silver — Muted helper text, icon strokes at rest

mist.$description: Mist — Subtle text on tinted surfaces

pearl.$description: Pearl — Secondary text, high-contrast metadata on dark

bone.$description: Bone — Hairline borders, dividers — the most-used neutral in the system

white.$description: White — Light supporting surface for subtle backgrounds and section separation. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

deep-navy.$description: Deep Navy — Dark blue-tinted surface for feature cards and section backgrounds

midnight-indigo.$description: Midnight Indigo — Blue-black card surface — second surface level above the canvas

aurora-blacklavender.$description: Aurora Black→Lavender — Signature hero gradient: black 0.85% → deep blue → violet → lavender → dusty pink — the single defining atmosphere of the brand

signal-blue.$description: Signal Blue — Secondary gradient pair for call-out strips and inline emphasis bars

aurora-wash.$description: Aurora Wash — Subtle blue-to-violet wash used for low-opacity decorative bands

inter.$description: Primary typeface for everything — display headlines, body, UI labels, nav. Weight 500–600 at 48–60px with aggressive negative tracking (-0.057em) gives the signature compressed, confident display feel. Body stays at 400/500 around 14–16px with light tracking. No chromatic CTA color — buttons rely on weight contrast alone.

ui-monospace.$description: Inline code, keyboard shortcuts (⌘⏎), and micro-typography moments. Treated as a whisper — always at 11px, always quiet next to Inter.

apple-system.$description: System font fallback reserved for very small UI labels and icons on Apple-only surfaces

flow-circular.$description: Custom brand typeface used in tightly limited contexts — a single monoline geometric that warms up the otherwise Inter-only system
